_about: Verdicts for the nightly course SLO read (step 11 of docs/reference/scheduled_sessions.md; Sam, 2026-11-01: "yes to SLO hints and the nightly harvest"). scripts/next_slo_colleges.py skips a college listed here. state: none (its public pages print no course SLOs), held (waits on what why names), parser (its pages print SLOs the reader does not parse yet: a build item). Keyed by harvest slug; by names the session, on the date, source the run or PR that shows it. A session adds a row when a trial or a read shows it, and removes one when what it waited on changes (a new catalog year, a parser fix).

bakersfield.why: its eLumen course pages print no SLOs
